Studio 404
*Is Back*
slides.sub: Sessions, the space, and one very festive truck

caption:
We've been quiet on here. That changes today. 👋

Studio 404 is a photo studio on St. Laurent in Ottawa. Here's what you'll see from us:

🎄 Christmas sessions on our brand new holiday set
📸 Real client sessions (families, couples, portraits)
💡 The space itself, for anyone who wants to rent it
🚚 Our Christmas truck, collecting warm clothing for people who need it

Follow along. December is going to be busy.
